title: CategorizeResponse
description: What `ai` returns from `POST /categorize`. Advisory only — `api` decides whether confidence clears the posting threshold (M6 T7); below it, the expense routes to a review queue instead of the ledger.

category.description: Must be one of the `categories` named in the request — `ai` never invents a taxonomy entry.

citation.description: The specific policy chunk text that justified this category, or null if no policy chunk was available or relevant — never a fabricated quote.
